From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-01-12T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: DPA redline and signature routing for Acme Cloud Retail

Priyom / Marissa — quick legal summary after reviewing Acme_DPA_redline_v1: see attached tracking doc (DPA_redline_tracking.docx). Main notes: 

- SCCs: Acceptable with one change — we need to retain Redwood's standard cross-border transfer language to align with our KMS/HSM practice. Suggested language in the tracking doc.
- Retention: We can narrow retention windows in Appendix B for EU data, but cannot commit to blanket deletion on customer request prior to agreed retention for audit/compliance purposes. Proposed compromise: 90-day deletion for ephemeral logs, 12 months for application-level backups, with an escalation path for data subject requests.
- Audit/Access: We can provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and a SOC summary but not raw internal evidence. Offer: scoped auditor access under NDA for enterprise customers on approved schedule.
- Indemnity & Cap: Counterproposal to indemnity language, maintain existing liability cap tied to fees.

Commercial ask for Sales: confirm whether Acme requires any changes to commercial signee (VP Legal vs CFO) — we should route to Marissa for legal sign-off and then to the appropriate exec for signature.

I'll mark the redlines in the document and highlight non-starters. If Acme agrees to the compromise on retention and the SCC tweak, we can sign next week.

Attachments: DPA_redline_tracking.docx

- Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — that is helpful. A few clarifications from our side (inline with your bullets):

- SCCs: Acme is OK with a Redwood-preserved transfer line if you can explicitly call out subprocessors and the KMS geo-loc in an appendix.
- Retention: The 90-day/12-month split sounds workable. We need a clear operational point of contact for data subject requests and a defined SLA (we usually ask 30 days).
- Auditor access: NDA and scheduled access is fine — we'll route that via our InfoSec team.

Tom (cc'd) — can you confirm whether Procurement will accept the proposed billing milestone schedule? Also, if possible, please confirm the preferred signature flow (DocuSign from Redwood or Acme).

If we can get agreement on the SCC appendix language and the 30-day DSAR SLA by Friday, we can proceed to signature. DocuSign preview (not an envelope): https://docusign.com/preview/ACM-DPA-2026
